latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of conference-talk-prepper – an end-to-end guide for conference speakers.

- Covers CFP/abstract writing, talk formatting, narrative structure, slide design, rehearsals, timing, demo safety, and Q&A handling.
- Supports first-time and intermediate speakers across engineering, design, business, and academic conferences.
- Offers practical templates, structure blueprints, and blunt coaching at every presentation stage.
- Helps with specific needs: CFP, outline, slides, rehearsals, pre/post logistics, branding, and demo recovery.
- Triggered by prompts such as "conference talk," "CFP," "keynote," "slide deck," and related terms.
